id./param/scenario/cs/a_070_cs_030.pack|cs_: Eeeeek! Oh no, I've set the whole thing on fire!
id./param/scenario/cs/a_070_cs_140.pack|cs_: Now then, Mr Scorpion—time for your punishment for tormenting the desert folk!
id./param/scenario/cs/a_070_cs_150.pack|cs_: Th-The chains came loose! It's still alive!
id./param/scenario/cs/a_070_cs_160.pack|cs_: It is scant consolation, but please take this. It is a traditional tool of the knights of Gallopolis.
Ring this monster bell, and it will summon nearby monsters to you. An excellent way to gain battle experience...or so I am told.
